result.title: MetaSkill: Reusable Problem-Solving Methods for Adaptive Skill Orchestration in LLM Agents
result.comment: 16 pages, including appendices. The MetaSkill library is provided as ancillary material
result.summary: Reusable skills provide specialized procedures, but large language model (LLM) agents must still determine how to organize and adapt their use. We introduce MetaSkill, a two-layer framework for reusing problem-solving methods across tasks and domains. The method layer selects from 26 curated methods and binds abstract roles to task objects. The execution layer uses the instantiated method to identify intermediate objectives, coordinate native skills, and guide repair or method reselection. On 89 SkillsBench tasks and 995 ToolHop examples, MetaSkill outperforms the evaluated baselines in all six configurations, with accuracy gains of 3.51-13.48% over the strongest baseline. Ablations support explicit method-guided orchestration beyond direct method injection and further gains from method reselection.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MetaSkill 两层框架：方法层从 26 种精选方法中挑选并把抽象角色绑定到任务对象，执行层据此确定中间目标、协调原生技能并指导修复或方法重选；在 SkillsBench 与 ToolHop 上均优于所评估基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 「抽象方法角色—中间目标—修复/重选」的编排结构可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态更新、停止与再规划决策形成类比，可供核查抽象方法表示能否约束推理轨迹；但材料未涉及视觉或多模态证据，联系仍属推测。
